commands: echo "ACTIONS=$GITHUB_ACTIONS RUN_ID=$GITHUB_RUN_ID REPO=$GITHUB_REPOSITORY"; git branch --show-current; git status --porcelain | head
gh pr view 1936 --json number,state,isDraft,headRefName,mergeable,mergeStateStatus 2>&1; echo "---AHEAD/BEHIND---"; git rev-list --left-right --count origin/main...HEAD 2>&1

ROOT=$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel 2>/dev/null || pwd)
mkdir -p "$ROOT/.prflow/tmp" 2>/dev/null || echo "MKDIR-FAILED"
[ -n "${ZSH_VERSION:-}" ] && setopt nonomatch || :
set -- "$ROOT"/.prflow/tmp/review/*/*/iter-*.json
if [ -e "$1" ]; then printf '%s\n' "$@" | sort; else echo "(no pre-existing iter files)"; fi

echo "=== EXT ===" && .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/load-prompt-extension.sh review 2>&1 | head -40; echo "ext-rc=${PIPESTATUS[0]}"; echo "=== BASE ==="; git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null || echo "no origin/main"

.prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/load-prompt-extension.sh review 2>&1 >/dev/null | tail -3; echo "---"; git merge-base HEAD origin/main 2>/dev/null; echo "---files---"; git diff --stat $(git merge-base HEAD origin/main)..HEAD 2>/dev/null | tail -30
grep -nE "echo|printf" scripts/../lib/resolve-gh.sh | grep -v ">&2" | head; echo ---; grep -n "stdout\|>&1\|echo\|printf" lib/resolve-gh.sh | head -30

git diff origin/main...HEAD -- lib/test/run.sh lib/test/modules/coverage-map.json .changeset/issue-1855-fold-label-config-outcome.md docs/internal/implement-skill.md docs/internal/DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md skills/implement/SKILL.md > /tmp/rest.diff; wc -l /tmp/rest.diff

git diff origin/main...HEAD -- lib/test/run.sh > /tmp/run_sh.diff; git diff origin/main...HEAD -- .changeset/issue-1855-fold-label-config-outcome.md docs/internal/implement-skill.md > /tmp/docs.diff; wc -l /tmp/run_sh.diff /tmp/docs.diff

grep -rln "EXEC_EDGES" --include=*.py lib/ scripts/ | grep -v test_python; echo "---DEF---"; grep -rn "EXEC_EDGES\s*=\|ensure-label" $(grep -rln "EXEC_EDGES =" --include=*.py lib/ scripts/ | grep -v test_python | head -1) 2>/dev/null | head

TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID=$(gh api "repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/1855/comments?per_page=100" --jq 'map(select((.body | contains("/prflow:implement")) and ((.body | test("(pr|dev)flow:workpad")) | not))) | last | .id' 2>/dev/null || true)
echo "TRIGGER=$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID"
if [ -n "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" ] && [ -z "${TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID//[0-9]/}" ]; then
  .prflow/vendor/prflow/scripts/react-to-trigger.sh --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" --event issue_comment --comment "$TRIGGER_COMMENT_ID" --reaction hooray --r …[per-command-truncated]

scrub.shapes: GitHub tokens/PATs, Anthropic keys, Bearer Authorization headers, and basic Authorization headers
